The device's absolute threshold affects all volumes; changing it also affects other disks. The percentage threshold can stay enabled.
Проверь DNS, время, доступность партнёро: Check DNS, time, replication partners and repadmin /replsummary. Correlate the event with its controller/partition; do not forcibly delete objects or recover AD without diagnosis.
Проверь findmnt, lsblk -f, df -h и журна: Check findmnt, lsblk -f, df -h and kernel logs. Check the agent account's access and storage health; do not format or repair filesystems without diagnosis and a backup.
Проверь free -h и процессы в top; сравни: Check free -h and top processes; compare usage over time. Inspect VM/container memory limits and OOM events. Do not clear caches or restart services blindly.

Проверь Get-Volume или свойства тома, ро: Check Get-Volume or volume properties, growing logs/backups and storage availability. Use standard cleanup or expansion after checking data; do not manually delete databases, transaction logs or system files.
Проверь Get-Volume, доступ службы агента: Check Get-Volume, agent service access, disk/RAID health and System events. Do not repair a filesystem blindly.
Проверь HTTPS-связь с сервером, время, д: Check server HTTPS connectivity, time, certificate trust and published agent package. Ensure the agent is confirmed and not revoked. An update download error alone does not mean monitoring is lost.
Проверь journalctl --system -n 20 --no-p: Run journalctl --system -n 20 --no-pager as the agent account and check saa-agent membership in systemd-journal. Restart the service after group changes. Check journal availability and rotation; denied access does not mean no events exist.
Проверь read-права учётной записи на /lo: Check read access to /log, API availability, logging configuration and RouterOS buffer usage. A working API alone does not confirm all logs are collected; inspect the detailed poll error. Do not clear the buffer to remove the warning.
Проверь SQL ERRORLOG, номер базы/страниц: Check SQL ERRORLOG, database/page identifiers and storage health; retain backups. Coordinate integrity checks with the DBA; do not use data-loss recovery modes based on one notification.
Проверь systemctl status sysadminassista: Check systemctl status sysadminassistant-agent-update.timer and journalctl -u sysadminassistant-agent-update.service -n 100 --no-pager.
Проверь аппаратные журналы, память, CPU,: Check hardware logs, RAM, CPU, temperature, firmware and hypervisor logs. Retain the full WHEA message to identify the component.
Проверь доступность адреса и порта API-S: Check Assistant-to-router API-SSL address/port access, route, read permissions, time and RouterOS certificate. ICMP does not confirm API health. Verify the fingerprint independently; do not disable TLS validation. Successful polls restore state automatically.
Проверь доступность удалённого конца и W: Check the remote end and WAN, tunnel state/logs on both ends, time, certificates and negotiation settings. Do not restart all VPNs or change the firewall before diagnosing the cause.
Проверь журнал обновления и статус служб: Check the update log, service status, server package integrity and previous working version.
Проверь журнал службы агента, права чтен: Check agent service logs, counter/volume read permissions and Windows components. Missing metrics do not mean zero load.
Проверь журнал службы обновления агента: Check agent update service logs and Windows Application/System.
Проверь монтирование и доступность храни: Check mounting and storage availability; the agent reported no values for this volume.
Проверь процессы и выделенную память в Д: Check processes and committed memory in Task Manager/Resource Monitor, SQL/VM limits and paging files. Determine whether one process's usage is growing.
Проверь разрешение указанного имени с се: Check name resolution from Assistant, configured DNS availability and responses. Distinguish DNS failure from host unavailability; do not replace DNS without checking the domain configuration.
Проверь реальное состояние защиты и поли: Check actual protection status and policies, other antivirus software and approved work. Do not disable protection to bypass the warning; correlate subsequent recovery events.
Проверь ресурсы, свободное место, состоя: Check resources, free space, storage health and the exact kernel/memory error. Retain logs and a configuration backup. Do not format storage or reset the router based on one message.
Проверь свободное место и права в катало: Check free space, permissions in the agent data/program folders, locked files and installer logs. Do not grant write access to everyone.
Проверь свободное место и состав файлов: Check free space and RouterOS files. Identify files and backups before cleanup; do not delete packages or unknown system files.
Проверь состояние DNS, загрузку зон, дос: Check DNS health, zone loading, AD/upstream availability and the exact event. On a domain controller, correlate with AD startup; do not modify zones blindly.
